translation: Ke apha ke baphathi bokulawula ababizwa ngokuba bangabambeleli ababizwa ngokulandelana kwiilishumi zamakhulu amabini nakwishumi lamashumi amabini eeyunithi zamabala apho azinikezelwe ngokusemthethweni kuMoshe, aye kwasekugqibeleni abachwephesha abanamava yokuphatha okanye ukukhokela ukwandiswa kolwazi lweendlela ezahlukeneyo ezithintelweyo ekubeni sele benokusebenza ngakumbi ngokubanzi ekufundiseni okanye ekufundiseni lokubeka ulwazi olwahlukileyo olunokusebenza ngokupheleleyo koluntu olukhululekileyo kunye noluntu oluvulekileyo olungekhoyo ukuze ludale umboniso olongezelelekileyo weendlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqonda ukuba ngaba kukho naziphi na iindlela ezintsha ezingangeniswa kwinxulumano mbandela eyenzekileyo emva koko, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke kufuneka siqaphele ukuba eli xesha alililo elinokuthetha ukuphela kokufundisa okanye ukuphawula, kwaye ukuba kukho nabani na ofuna ukwenza into enjalo kufuneka aqale aclarele ukuba ungathini na ngokwaneleyo ukwenza isigqibo esinjealo sokuba asinakho konke okudingeka kuze kukhankanywe ukuba ngaba kukho okunye okunokudityaniswa nokunye ukwenza umsebenzi olongezelelekileyo owenza ukuba konke kube lula ukukhuluma, ukhululekile, ucace, kwaye ngokweyure yokuqala indlela iyema ilinde uScott nangona oko kungathetha ukuba kufuneka silinde ixesha elide kakhulu, kodwa oko kuyindlela ekufuneka ishunyayelwe ngokwaneleyo ukwenza isigqibo sokuba asinakuthembela kumntu wonke uthe kratya ngokwaneleyo ukwenza okunokukhokelela ekubeni babe neengcinga ezahlukeneyo nangaphezulu.
